rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Did we get through...?! Where's everyone..."
Touya: "We can't go back... So it's just us from here on..."
Leone: "..."
Touya: "Leone, are you all right?"
Leone: "...Y-yeah... I'm all right...
What happened, I wonder?"
Touya: "I don't know. But if we can't go back, we've got to go forward."
Leone: "Yeah, you're right... Let's go..."
Touya: "Is this the 'Core'?"
Yamato: "It's ridiculously huge..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What the... Straight into my head..."
Leone: "...What's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Leone: "No, I can't..."
Touya: "I see...
Someone is speaking directly into my head right now."
Leone: "???"
Voice: (At last, someone has made it here...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, of course... How about this?
Does the voice sound familiar now?)
Touya: (That's... Debish!?
You're still alive?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What's so funny?!)
Voice: (...No, excuse me.
Your thinking was just so simplistic.
I was indeed within him once, but I am not him.
Let's see... You may think of me
as a being like that Lin Karma person
who accompanied you.)
Touya: (Disembodied consciousness that can exist after losing its body...)
Voice: (I am something purer and more fundamental, though.
In any case, you've done very well.
I never imagined that failure back then would lead to this.)
Touya: (Back then... You mean, 109 years ago...)
Voice: (Exactly. I thought it would work...
But it produced a talent like you,
so perhaps it was not a mistake in the end.
They all did well for me.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
Every one of them devoted themselves to me...)
Touya: (What the hell are you after?)
Voice: (...You humans of the Solar System were truly amusing
creatures.
You can sacrifice your own kind without hesitation for your desires,
yet you also try to save them...
It is fascinating.
I never tire of watching you.
What was the word...? Ah,
in your world, do you call it 'entertainment'?)
Touya: ('Entertainment'... You say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
Your struggles, your suffering... And the way you still stand against me.
Nothing beats the thrill
of real combat with lives at stake... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why would you do something like that?!)
Voice: (Why? What a funny question.
Because I'm bored, of course.
For us, freed from the shackles of time,
capable even of creating the future,
daily existence is nothing but tedium.
That is why chosen beings like myself
enjoy games like this to pass the time.
Yes, risking the loss of our own existence.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
Just for that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever simply existed
within time flowing aimlessly by?
Nothing changes, and the same time simply passes...
At first, I too accepted that as natural.
I never even questioned it. But I was wrong.
When I watched humans on distant worlds
far beyond our galaxy, living their fleeting lives,
they brought a time of fulfillment to my empty heart.
They risked their lives, fought, and won, showing me
the radiance of life. The exhilaration I felt
was understood by only a very few.
But that does not matter.
Now my time is so fulfilling.)
Touya: (I'll never forgive you... Toying with people's lives
to amuse yourself... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good, yes. Come at me like that.
Humanity's future is in your hands now.
Or rather, in that Rayblade you pilot.)
Touya: (What do you mean?)
Voice: (Throughout recorded history, whenever humanity faced danger,
there was always something to stop it, wasn't there?
Sometimes a person, sometimes a sword,
and sometimes an idea...
Something suited to the times saved humanity.
Have you never wondered why
such convenient things happen?)
Touya: (D-don't tell me...)
Voice: (Yes, it was me. Those fools of Lin Karma
seem to have thought they sealed Vorlia away.
But I could have left such a place whenever I wished.
I didn't because there was no need.
Above all, it kept them from interfering.
It was convenient for playing with you humans,
who only patch up appearances and never learn anything fundamental.
...And this time, that Rayblade is
the 'key' to humanity's salvation.
The only thing capable of stopping this Vorlia.
That is why you were able to come this far...)
Touya: (...But if we're alive here now,
doesn't it mean you lost in the past?)
Voice: (No. They failed. They could not even
reach me... So all of them sank into history,
their ambitions unfulfilled...)
Touya: (...Then I'll end it this time.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager must be made
on equal terms. If I keep myself somewhere safe,
I cannot experience true enjoyment.
You might call it suspense.
It multiplies the pleasure many times over.
That is why I have given you this chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (If you destroy this 'Core' with Rayblade,
Vorlia and I will be unable to sustain our existence, and will vanish.
Then this world will be saved...
Hehehe... Now then, may I begin?)
Touya: "..."
Leone: "...Touya?"
Touya: "..."
Leone: "Touya... Are you all right?"
Touya: "...Huh? Y-yeah... I was... talking just now..."
Yamato: "Talking, meow...? In those few seconds?"
Touya: "...A few seconds...? I see..."
Voice: (Surprised? I can do things like this too.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a monster...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Shall we begin, then...?)
Yamato: "M-meow, what's that?!"
Leone: "A black Rayblade..."
Touya: "...Let's go."
Yamato: "Huh?"
Touya: "If we beat it, everything will be over."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya! What in the..."
Leone: "...We won't lose, will we?
We're going to win, aren't we...?"
Touya: "Of course. Like hell we're dying here.
I said we'd make it back alive, didn't I?"
Leone: "That's... right... Cough, cough..."
Touya: "Leone!"
Leone: "Pant, pant... I-I'm all right... Let's go...
And we're going to win... Okay...?"
Voice: (...Hm? You're damaged...
It won't be entertaining unless you fight
in perfect condition... Very well.)
Yamato: "What?! No way, the damage... It's repaired, meow..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, entertain me!)
Touya: (Let's put an end to this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehehe... Very well.
Then end it all with your own hands...)
Touya: (I don't need you to tell me!)
Voice: (Good. You're quite entertaining...
But it seems this is as far as you'll go...
Well, this time some excellent pawns
have made things quite enjoyable... But
it is time to say goodbye...)
Voice: (...So you have disappointed me...
You were doing well until now...
Still, this time some excellent pawns
have made things quite enjoyable... So
I'll erase you instantly, without suffering...)
Touya: "Damn...... Leone... I'm sorry..."
Leone: "..."
Voice: (What?! I-impossible... You...!)
Kasumi: "Touya! Leone! Yamato!
Are you all right?!"
Touya: "Kasumi!"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're having trouble."
Arthur: "Isn't it unfair
for you to take all the glory yourselves?"
Leone: "...Everyone..."
Aurelie: "We managed to make it in time."
Fain: "With us here, you can rest easy!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Melissa: "It really is better when everyone's together."
Celica: "This is how a finale should be!"
Gen: "I'll make a cool showing for the finale too!"
Melvi: "I'm here too!"
Voice: (Why... How could you break that barrier...?)
Rayfon: (Don't underestimate the people of this world.
These humans who have established their 'individuality.'
Each one is weak, but when they join together,
they display greater strength than you expect...
That is what characterizes these humans.
Their imperfection makes them try to compensate
through cooperation with others. That creates
an unpredictable power that numbers cannot explain.
Trust, friendship, love... It takes many forms.
Do you know its name?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (Its name... is 'bonds.'
You believe only in yourselves and trust nobody.
No one relies on you, and you love no one.
I doubt you can understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Interesting! More and more interesting!
Very well! I grant you all the right
to take part in this wager!)
Voice: (...!? Why?! Why won't they appear?!)
Rishuna: (It's useless. I've sealed off this space.
You cannot summon anything now.)
Voice: (Damn...)
Valga: (It's time to end this.)
Voice: (It seems... I underestimated you a little...
But I can do this too...)
Clovis: "What?! What's happening...?"
Arthur: "Illusions...? No, that's not it..."
Xiujian: "...So the last enemy is ourselves..."
Voice: (Now, let the delightful festivities begin!!)
Touya: "Leone, are you all right?"
Leone: "...Yeah."
Touya: "Just a little more... Can you do it?"
Leone: "Leave it to me... Touya..."
Touya: "Hm?"
Leone: "Thank you... for falling in love with me..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "I'm so happy...
I want to be your special person forever..."
Touya: "Of course you will. The person most precious to me
is you, Leone."
Leone: "Ehehehe..."
Touya: "...Let's go."
Leone: "...Okay."
Clovis: "Th-this is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Celica: "I can't believe it..."
Leone: "Oh... Everyone..."
Clovis: "Are you both safe?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...It looks like the battle is decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here too, you know..."
Voice: (...Splendid... You've entertained me quite well...)
Touya: (It's over.)
Voice: (Hehehehehe... Yes...
But this is not the end of everything...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I will vanish, certainly.
But unless the Core ceases to exist,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...It was most enjoyable...
Experiencing destruction isn't so bad... after all...)
Touya: (W-wait! How do I make the Core disappear?!)
Voice: (...I told you Rayblade was the key...
You must figure out what to do for yourself...)
Touya: (The key... Myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... It's a pity I cannot
see it to the end, but I wish you luck... Farewell...)
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Touya?"
Touya: "O-oh... Sorry."
Yamato: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "...No, nothing..."
Leone: "...Touya... You can't...
It's written all over your face that you're lying..."
Touya: "...You see right through everything, don't you?"
Leone: "...That's right. When it comes to you...
I know everything... So..."
Yamato: "Huh? M-meow, what?
Is Vorlia... moving?
What in the meow...?"
Touya: "...Tch. It won't even give me time to think..."
Touya: "...Hear me out."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you switching to transmit mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Leone: "..."
Yamato: "Leone...?"
Leone: "...Don't... This must be hard for Touya too...
Let's... believe in him and follow him... Okay?"
Yamato: "O-okay..."
Leone: "..."
Yamato: "Leone..."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core.
But only this Rayblade can do it.
So I want you to go back ahead of us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell do you mean?!"
Touya: "...I know it's selfish
to say this after we've come this far.
But it isn't because I don't believe in you.
I want you to return because I believe in you, because I trust you.
Give me the reassurance of having a place to return to,
a place I have to return to..."
Clovis: "Hey, you can't say that after we've come all this way.
We're staying with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... Do you think we'll just obey
if you tell us to go back? I haven't sunk so low
that I'd dump everything on a comrade and leave alone."
Arthur: "How cold... I'll accompany you to the end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'll stick with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We should face reality calmly.
There's nothing we can do as we are now.
It's frustrating... But it's true.
We shouldn't make things any harder for him.
If we really trust him, if we really are his comrades,
we should leave this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you must honor
your promise to return."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll try."
Clovis: "Touya... No, never mind.
It's only a short parting."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "......I won't say farewell."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah. Neither will I."
Arthur: "...Be careful..."
Fain: "......Damn!"
Touya: "I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Fain: "...A-all right! But don't you dare die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Touya... I'll be waiting.
So I won't say goodbye..."
Touya: "Yeah. Just wait a little while."
Kasumi: "Okay. I understand...... Be safe."
Touya: "...I'll be going."
Yamato: "Tou... Don't tell me you're going to ram it with Rayblade?"
Touya: "Oh, you really do get it."
Yamato: "...I knew it... Why can boys only think
of rough ways to do things, meow?"
Touya: "Is there any other way?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Maybe meowt."
Touya: "...See? Hey, Leone, you too...
Leone? What's wrong?! Leone!!"
Leone: "Pant, pant... T-Touya..."
Touya: "Leone! Stay with me!"
Leone: "...Don't look like that.
It isn't your fault...
This is... what I w-wanted... So...
Don't be sad... Don't blame yourself...
Pant, pant..."
Touya: "H-hey, Leone..."
Leone: "Tell me, Touya...
Was I... useful to you...?"
Touya: "Y-yeah... Of course.
I got this far because you were here."
Leone: "Ehehehe... I'm... glad..."
I held Leone close.
<FC:5A:3E>    There was a faint, sweet scent.
<FC:5A:3E>     It was Leone's scent...
Leone: "...Your heartbeat...
Your body... is warm..."
Her voice was almost too faint to hear.
<FC:5A:3E> I simply held Leone in silence.
<FC:5A:3E>  Leone put her arms around my back too.
<FC:5A:3E>      Slowly...
I don't know how much time passed.
<FC:5A:3E>     I wished time would stop like this.
<FC:5A:3E>       I truly did.
<FC:5A:3E>         But...
Touya: "!?"
The arms around my back slowly slipped down...
Leone: "..."
Leone gave the brightest smile she could,
<FC:5A:3E>  and gently placed her hand on my cheek.
Leone: "..."
Leone tried to say something.
<FC:3C:3E> Leone's lips formed words without a voice.
Leone: "..."
Touya: "Leone...?
This isn't real... Tell me it isn't real... Please..."
Yamato: "Touya..."
Touya: "Sob... Leone...
Leone! Leoooooone!!!!"
Touya: "..."
Touya: "...Leone... I'm sorry..."
Yamato: "Touya..."
Touya: "...I'll stop Vorlia.
Even if it costs me my life..."
Yamato: "Touya, let's go!"
Touya: "Uooooooooh!!"
